examples.arabic: كان أبو كرم وعائلته عم يتناولوا العشا سوا، والعين على التلفزيون يلي عم يبث أخبار اليوم الحصرية.
examples.english: Abu Karam and his family were having dinner together, with their eyes on the television broadcasting today's exclusive news.
examples.transliteration: Kaan Abu Karam w 3a'ilto 3am yetnawalu el 3asha sawa, wel 3ayn 3ala el talafizyon illi 3am yebeth akhbar el yom el 7usriyyeh.

examples.arabic: الكل قعد على السفرة وعيلتنا انبسطت بالعشا كتير
examples.english: Everyone sat at the dining table and our family enjoyed dinner a lot.
examples.transliteration: El-kull qaʿad ʿala s-sufra w ʿēltna inbaṣṭat bil-ʿasha ktīr.

examples.english: We all ate a delicious dinner together.

examples.arabic: بدي اطبخ العشا بس ما في خبز
examples.english: I want to cook dinner but there is no bread.
examples.transliteration: Biddi aṭbukh el-ʻasha bas ma fī khubz.

examples.arabic: قال لي عندي سبع شغلات لازم اخلصها قبل العشا
examples.english: He told me, "I have seven things I need to finish before dinner."
examples.transliteration: qāl lī ʿandi sabʿa shaghlāt lāzim akhalliṣha qabl al-ʿasha

examples.arabic: بعد شوي امي رح تجي و رح ناكل عشا عالطاولة
examples.english: Later, my mom will come and we will eat dinner at the table.
examples.transliteration: ba'ed shway emmi rah teji w rah nakol asha aal tawle
